extracted.name: Brussels Sprouts with Mushrooms
extracted.description: An easy Brussels sprouts and mushrooms recipe. Boiled Brussels sprouts get tossed with sautéed mushrooms and seasoned with lemon and parsley.
ingredient_lines: 4 cups Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
instruction_lines: Cook Brussels sprouts in a pot of lightly salted boiling water for 15 minutes, or until fork-tender; strain through a colander, removing as much water as possible. Set aside.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir mushrooms until lightly browned.
Toss Brussels sprouts with mushrooms and sprinkle with parsley, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Serve immediately.
